verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents its own Inspector and Scene Inspector for runtime debugging and scene analysis, plus scene optimization. The community credits Spector, a WebGL frame debugger, to Babylon. Together these give some first-party tooling for analyzing heavy scenes, but none of it is explicitly described as a performance profiler, and the pack never mentions ECS, a job system, or instancing. missing for 10: an explicitly documented CPU/GPU performance profiler with frame timing, instancing/thin-instance support, ECS or data-oriented architecture, a jobs/worker-based parallelism system, and independent evidence of scaling heavy scenes.
